Today’s M&A briefing — 14 deals, the strategies behind them · 27 November 2026

🔹 Vinci Concessions (vinci Group's infrastructure concessions subsidiary) acquires 50.04% stake in LISEA held by Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (concession company for the Tours-Bordeaux Sud Europe Atlantique high-speed rail line) — €2.1bn.
Vinci already held a stake in LISEA before this transaction; the acquisition of an additional 8.0% gives it a majority. The transaction values LISEA's equity at 2.1 billion euros.

🔹 Rossel (belgian press group, publisher of La Voix du Nord) takes exclusive control of Socibog (parent company of the Sud Ouest group).

🔹 Christie's (global auction house controlled by the Pinault family, 3.6 billion pounds in global sales in 2025) acquires Dreweatts (british auction house founded in 1759).

🔹 Ciclad (fonds Si Vis Pacem) (french investment fund dedicated to SMEs) takes control of Selva (SME founded in 1979 in Vallet).

🔹 Granions Laboratoire (brand of the Olyos group, a French player) acquires Luxéol (specialized hair care brand, number three).

🔹 Blue Elephant Energy (renewable energy asset developer) acquires 95 % du projet de stockage par batterie Zuidvelde.

🔹 Itago SGR (fonds Itago IV) (italian investment fund) acquires a controlling stake in Cariboni (designer and producer of custom oleo-hydraulic systems for high-end racing and pleasure sailboats, founded in 1984 in Ronco Briantino).

🔹 Customs Support Group (CSG) (independent provider of customs and international trade solutions in Europe, 16 offices and over 300 employees in Italy) acquires TSD Cargo (customs broker based in Turin, founded in 1976).

🔹 Ca' Zampa acquires Centro Veterinario Genovese (veterinary clinic in Genoa offering general medicine, diagnostics, surgery, emergencies, and several specialties).

🔹 Macre 2014 (holding de la famille Radici) (holding company of the Bergamo entrepreneur Angelo Radici's family, formerly a shareholder of RadiciGroup, chemicals and polymers) acquires 70% of Liski (designer and producer of protection and slope preparation equipment for ski resorts and sports systems, based in Brembate, Bergamo).

🔹 Sandvik (swedish group specializing) intends to acquire Del Rey Minerals (brazilian manufacturer of wear and spare parts).

🔹 Interduct (dutch group specializing) acquires Ventilatie Service Nederland (VSN) (installation and maintenance of ventilation systems in existing buildings, Netherlands).

🔹 Movere acquires Transport Savikko (transporter specializing in heavy).

🔹 Phoenix Group (building technical services company based in Stoke) acquires Harveys (L. Harvey and Son) (third-generation family business founded in 1964).

en.text:
Today’s fundraising briefing — 9 deals, the strategies behind them · 27 November 2026

🔹 Korben (AI platform enabling fleets of service robots — cleaning, reception, shelf stocking) — €10.2m.
Co-founded by Lucas Goumarre. Over its last eight months of activity, Korben reported 500,000 euros in EBITDA. Post-money valuation: 36.2 million euros.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: R&D and cloud (nearly two-thirds of funds), 70 recruitments.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: TIRESIAS ANGELS (majority investor), Bpifrance (2 M€), two private banks.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Korben is building the orchestration layer between robots of different brands and operators — whoever controls this layer receives a royalty on each deployed fleet, regardless of the hardware brand.

🔹 Alpha Impulsion (development of autophagous space propulsion technology — the rocket fuselage serves as fuel) — €10m. Fundraising in progress — target amount, not yet finalized.
Founded in 2022 by three former aeronautical engineers. Member of Alliance 2030+, which is developing the Grenat program, a 15-ton thrust autophagous propulsion rocket engine for microlauchers. Fundraising planned for early 2027.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Industrialization of autophagous propulsion technologies.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: A technology that eliminates the mass of the structural tank fundamentally changes the economic equation for microlauchers; Alpha Impulsion claims to be the only team in the world working on its industrialization for complete launchers.

🔹 WaterSense (real-time water quality monitoring infrastructure for industrial sites, public services, cities) — €5.75m · Pre-seed.
Founded by Filip Budny, Mateusz Korona, and Kacper Orzeszko. Supplemented by 3.5 million euros in non-dilutive funding from the Polish National Centre for Research and Development (NCBR).
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: b2venture and Movens Capital (co-leads), vastpoint.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Proprietary hardware creates a data entry barrier: whoever controls the sensors controls the data flow and thus the value of the predictive model, following the same logic as a private meteorological network.

🔹 General Catalyst — €4.5m · pre-seed.

🔹 Permut (AI conversational agent platform for sales and customer relations, for brands and organizations) — €3m · Seed.

🔹 ARK Capture Solutions (electric and solvent-free CO₂ capture technology for industrial sites, founded) — €2.2m · Seed.

🔹 Sequent (formal verification tool) — $2.2m · Pre-seed.

🔹 Stav.ai (software gateway between enterprise applications and AI models) — $1.09m · Seed.

🔹 SmartBoat (open marine operating system enabling communication between onboard electronic equipment) — £500,000. Fundraising in progress — target amount, not yet finalized.

Fondée en 2022 par trois anciens ingénieurs aéronautiques. Membre de l'Alliance 2030+, qui développe le programme Grenat, un moteur-fusée de 15 tonnes de poussée à propulsion autophage pour microlanceurs. Levée prévue pour début 2027.
𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗳 : Industrialisation des technologies de propulsion autophage.
